title: AgentMesh Task Payload (DRAFT)
description: PROPOSED unified JSON payload for task delegation and outcomes in AgentMesh. This is a draft for Phase 1 discussion; nothing here is finalized or implemented.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task. Assignment owner (delegator vs. executor) and idempotency rules are open questions.

conversation_id.description: Identifier correlating all tasks that belong to one logical workflow, constant across the workflow.

capability.description: The advertised capability the delegator is invoking (must match a capability in the target agent's manifest).

context.description: Structured input the agent needs: instructions, documents, prior results, references. Shape is capability-specific.

constraints.description: Optional delegator-declared limits. A receiving agent must honor a constraint or reject the task explicitly.

deadline.description: Absolute UTC deadline after which the task may be timed out (ISO 8601).

timeout_seconds.description: Relative deadline measured from task acceptance.

max_result_bytes.description: Maximum size of the serialized result.

status.description: Current task state. See docs/task-lifecycle.md for the proposed lifecycle.

result.description: Structured output produced on successful completion (required when status is 'completed').

summary.description: Optional short human-readable summary of the result.

error.description: Structured error information on failure (required when status is 'rejected', 'failed' or 'timed_out').

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Exact taxonomy is an open Phase 1 question.

retryable.description: Whether the delegator should consider re-submitting this task.

usage.description: Optional, informational execution metadata for observability and cost accounting.

allOf.$comment: A completed task must carry a result.
A rejected, failed or timed-out task must carry an error.
